FengyunDeeper_Electric.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While in party, Water Pals drop more items when defeated. The drop rate increases with Partner Skill level. From Lv. 2 onward, Ride Speed also increases while mounted.

BluePlatypus.name: Surfing Slam
BluePlatypus.description: When activated, Fuack body surfs toward an enemy and slams into them with a 1.5x/1.6x/1.8x/2.1x/2.5x damage multiplier.

Kirin.name: Swift Deity
Kirin.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's and Pals' Electric damage dealt to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

Serpent.name: Swift Swimmer
Serpent.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. Riding Speed is increased by 10/12/15/20% at higher Partner Skill levels. Sometimes drops 1/2/3/4/5 Leather when assigned to a Ranch.

PurpleSpider.name: Tarantriss' Web
PurpleSpider.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Can also shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed. Grapple Cooldown: 4/3/2/1/0 seconds. From Lv. 2-5, Ride Speed while mounted increases by 10/12/15/20%.

FlowerDinosaur_Electric.name: Thunder Dragon
FlowerDinosaur_Electric.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the Defense of Electric Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. (Does not stack)

ThunderBird.name: Thunderous
ThunderBird.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Electric Pal in your party (excluding Beakon).

Horus_Water.name: Tidal Predator
Horus_Water.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Fire Pals drop 40%/50%/60%/70%/80% more items when defeated.

FlameBambi.name: Tiny Spark
FlameBambi.description: While in party, increases the Defense of Fire Pals by 15/17/20/24/30%. Sometimes drops 1/2/3/4/5 Flame Organs when assigned to a Ranch. (Does not stack)

LizardMan.name: Too Cool to be Seen
LizardMan.description: When activated, Leezpunk and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for 10/12/14/16/20 seconds. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15/8 seconds.

LizardMan_Fire.name: Too Cool to be Seen
LizardMan_Fire.description: When activated, Leezpunk and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for 10/12/14/16/20 seconds. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15/8 seconds.

HawkBird.name: Travel Companion
HawkBird.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Movement speed increases by 10/12/15/20% at Lv. 2-5.

ClownRabbit.name: Trick-Loving Fluffle
ClownRabbit.description: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player (Fire / Power: 100/110/130/160/200, Burn buildup: 777). Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack increases by 30/35/40/45/50%.

CatBat.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
CatBat.description: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap within 100/110/130/160/200 meters, expanding by 30/35/40/45/50 meters per second. Cooldown: 60/50/45/40/30 seconds.

WhiteAlienDragon.name: Unknown Intruder
WhiteAlienDragon.description: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage by 10/15/20/25/35%.

DarkAlien.name: Unknown Invader
DarkAlien.description: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by 100/110/120/135/160%.

MonochromeQueen.name: Untainted Maiden
MonochromeQueen.description: While in party, increases the player's Attack by 30/40/50/60/80% if all Pals in party are different species. (Does not stack)

CaptainPenguin_Black.name: Unyielding Storm Commander
CaptainPenguin_Black.description: While in party, improves the player's and Party Pals' Water damage to enemy weak points by 25/27/30/34/40%. (Does not stack)

BerryGoat_Dark.name: Venom Picker
BerryGoat_Dark.description: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores 100/120/140/160/200 Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes.

Ronin_Dark.name: Void Blade
Ronin_Dark.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Iaigiri, dealing 1.1x/1.3x/1.6x/2.0x/2.5x damage. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by 30/35/42/51/65% while not in combat. (Does not stack)

HoodGhost.name: Void-Dweller
HoodGhost.description: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by 50/60/70/80/100%.

FlameBuffalo.name: Warm Body
FlameBuffalo.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Cold Resistance +2. Riding Speed is increased by 10/12/15/20% at higher Partner Skill levels. (Does not stack)

StuffedShark.name: Water Gun
StuffedShark.description: When activated, Finsider changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

BlueDragon.name: Waterwing Dance
BlueDragon.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%. Increases swimming speed by 10/14/18/25% at Partner Skill Lv. 2/3/4/5.

FengyunDeeper.name: Wind and Clouds
FengyunDeeper.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Increases mounted Movement Speed by 10/12/15/20% at Partner Skill Lv. 2/3/4/5.

HadesBird.name: Wings of Death
HadesBird.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dark and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

Suzaku.name: Wings of Flame
Suzaku.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku)

HadesBird_Electric.name: Wings of Thunder
HadesBird_Electric.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

Suzaku_Water.name: Wings of Water
Suzaku_Water.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by 5/9/13/18/25% for each other Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku Aqua)

WindChimes_Ice.name: Winter Trapeze
WindChimes_Ice.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider, enabling slow ascension while gliding with 0.009/0.008/0.007/0.006 Gravity Scale and 9/8/7/6 Stamina consumption at higher Partner Skill levels.

IceWitch.name: Witch's Icy Veil
IceWitch.description: When activated, Icelyn changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 30/35/40/45/50%.

AmaterasuWolf.name: Wolf of the Sun
AmaterasuWolf.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player and Party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. Riding Speed is increased by 10/12/15/20% at higher Partner Skill levels. (Does not stack)

SoldierBee.name: Worker Bee
SoldierBee.description: While in party, increases Elizabee's Attack. Sometimes drops 1/2/3/4/5 Honey when assigned to a Ranch.

WeaselDragon.name: Wriggling Weasel
WeaselDragon.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dragon and increases Attack by 5/7/10/14/20%.

ElecPanda.name: Yellow Tank
ElecPanda.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted, dealing 6.5/7/7.5/8.5/9.5 damage.

SumoDog.name: Yokozuna's Presence
SumoDog.description: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15/17/20/24/30% less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify.

FlyingManta.name: Zephyr Glider
FlyingManta.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and increases high-speed gliding speed to 600/750/900/1,050/1,200.
